english.title: Selling tobacco to person under 18 years of age - Children and Young Persons Act 1933
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCT SOLD - SEE NOTE BELOW..) to **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a person under the age of 18 years
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7(1) of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
sell tobacco to a person under 18 years of age

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The product sold may be tobacco including cigarettes and any product containing tobacco for oral or nasal use (e.g. chewing tobacco or snuff) and smoking mixtures intended as a substitute for tobacco (e.g. herbal mixtures).
Cigarettes include: cut tobacco rolled up in paper, tobacco leaf (e.g. cigars) or other material in such form as to be capable of immediate use for smoking.
(ii) Offence covers sale to person both for that person's own use or for any other person's use.
(iii) Section 7(5) defines tobacco.
(iv) See section 7(1A) for defence.
